## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender girl with a pale, fine-featured face, broad forehead, pointed chin, and expressive gray eyes that change under different lights. Originally having fiery red hair and heavy freckles, her hair darkens into a rich auburn as she grows older, worn at times in curls, braids, or stylish pompadours. She possesses a natural, graceful poise and a sweet, vivid smile that illuminates her face.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c8 P55](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0055), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c20 P6](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0006), [v1 c28 P5](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0005), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v3 c29 P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 c33 P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018), [v4 c12 P18](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0018)_

## Personality

Extremely imaginative, vivid, and romantic, Nell perceives beauty in all surrounding nature and routinely invents poetic names for locations and objects. Though she possesses a fiery, quick temper when provoked—especially regarding her appearance—she is deeply empathetic, sincere, generous, and swift to forgive. She has an enthusiastic passion for learning, reading, and literature, maintaining a sunny, cheerful optimism even amidst setbacks. Her deep loyalty to those she loves guides her choices, leading her to willingly sacrifice her own ambitions for duty and the well-being of others.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c2 P56](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0056), [v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c13 P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v2 c1 P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023), [v4 c7 P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## History

Arriving at Grey Shutters as an eleven-year-old orphan mistaken for a boy, Nell quickly wins over the timid Obed Abernethy and stern Thirza Abernethy with her loquacious, imaginative spirit. She forms a deep friendship with her neighbor Isolde Pembroke, naming local landmarks such as Linger Lane, Reedmere, and the Nymph's Well. Attending Brierley school, she engages in a fiery academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow that evolves over time into a deep mutual affection. After a tragic mix-up involving an amethyst brooch and a missed picnic, she integrates fully into community life and Sunday-school. When Obed Abernethy dies of a heart attack following the failure of the Abbey Bank, Nell declines a university scholarship to stay in Brierley and teach school so Thirza will not have to sell Grey Shutters. She saves the life of young Posy Fay during a bout of croup and continues her own studies at home, eventually attending Regent's Academy, where she wins the prestigious Avery Scholarship. Rather than entering university immediately, she teaches for two years at Brierley School to earn her own way. She later attends Wexcombe College, living at 'Tabby's Place' with college friends and earning High Honors in English. After rejecting a proposal from Cyril Lisle, she realizes her true love is Hugh Carrow. Following her graduation, she marries Hugh in the orchard at Grey Shutters and moves to his new medical practice at Seven Gulls Harbor, living in their 'house of dreams.' There she gives birth to a daughter, Joy, who dies in infancy, but she later finds healing and joy in raising her son, Little Kit.

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia, to schoolteacher parents Edmund and Bertha Harcourt who both died of fever when she was an infant  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by hand by a poor woman named Mrs. Thomas until age eight  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived in a clearing with Mrs. Rudge, helping care for three consecutive sets of twins, before being placed in the Marden orphan asylum  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by Obed and Thirza Abernethy of Grey Shutters in Brierley, St. Brendan's Island, due to a mix-up when they requested a boy  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)</sub>
